string.name: close
string.comment: Button in the installer dialog that closes it once installation has finished or failed. In the single-app installer it sits next to Start. Single short verb.

string.name: exit
string.comment: Overflow menu item on the app list screen and in the in-game menu. Closes the app; while a MIDlet is running it asks for confirmation before stopping it. Keep it short.

string.name: about
string.comment: Main screen overflow menu item. Opens the About dialog with version, links and licenses. One word, no trailing period.

string.name: help
string.comment: Overflow menu item on the app list screen, and toolbar button in the Shader/Soundbank file manager. Opens the Help dialog. Short noun.

string.name: more
string.comment: Button in the About dialog that expands the full column of links and credits. One short word.

string.name: search
string.comment: Title and accessibility label of the search icon in the app list toolbar; tapping it opens an inline search field that filters installed apps by name as the user types. Single word.

string.name: licenses
string.comment: Button in the About dialog that opens the list of open-source licenses bundled with the app. Plural noun.

string.name: profiles
string.comment: Overflow menu item and Settings row title. Opens the Profiles screen: named sets of per-app emulator settings that can be applied to other apps.

string.name: save_log
string.comment: Overflow menu item on the app list and in the in-game menu. Writes the emulator log to a file; the toast 'Log has been saved' follows.

string.name: about_message
string.comment:
First paragraph of the About dialog: one-sentence description of the app and the games it supports. Ends with
markup that makes a line break; keep the tag.

resources.string: Diese App erlaubt es dir, J2ME Apps und Spiele auf deinem Androidgerät zu benutzen. Die meisten 2D und 3D Spiele werden bereits unterstützt (Mascot Capsule 3D eingeschlossen).

string.name: help_message
string.comment:
Body of the Help dialog: two bullet points separated by
, mentioning the option 'Immediate processing mode' by name. Keep the bullet character (•), the
tags and keep the option name identical to the PREF_IMMEDIATE translation.

resources.string:
• Das Aktivieren der Filterung kann in einigen Fällen die Leistung erheblich beeinträchtigen. Deaktivieren Sie diese Option, wenn das Spiel zu langsam ist.
• Bildflimmerprobleme können behoben werden, indem die Option \"Sofortiger Verarbeitungsmodus\" aktiviert wird.

string.name: author
string.comment: Prefix placed directly before the app author name in app details (the name is appended, so the trailing space is required). Leave the space after the colon.

string.name: version
string.comment: Prefix placed directly before an app version number: in the About dialog and in app details. Leave the trailing space, the number is appended.

string.name: no_data_for_display
string.comment: Empty-state text centered in lists: app list with no installed apps, Profiles screen, shader/soundbank file manager. Short, neutral, no period.

string.name: message_delete
string.comment: Confirmation dialog message when deleting an installed app from its long-press menu. The buttons are Delete and Cancel; 'app' means the installed game.

resources.string: Möchten Sie diese App wirklich löschen?

string.name: permission_request_failed
string.comment: Message when the storage permission the emulator needs was denied. Used both as a dialog message (buttons Retry and Exit) and as a toast.

string.name: external_storage_not_mounted
string.comment: Error about missing external storage from earlier versions. Not referenced by the current code: storage checks now use a different flow. Low priority.

string.name: create
string.comment: Lowercase positive button in the missing-working-directory dialog: creates the folder at the shown path. Also used as a plain verb label.

string.name: alert_msg_workdir_not_exists
string.comment: Startup dialog when the working directory where apps are stored does not exist. %1$s = full folder path, shown inside straight quotes on its own line. Buttons: Create, Change, Exit.

resources.string: Arbeitsverzeichnis existiert nicht im Pfad:\n\'%1$s\'.\nMöchten Sie es erstellen oder ein anderes auswählen?

string.name: action_context_shortcut
string.comment: Long-press context menu item for an installed app. Adds a launcher shortcut that starts this MIDlet directly.

string.name: action_reinstall
string.comment: Long-press context menu item for an installed app. Runs the installer again for the same JAR/JAD and keeps app data.

string.name: action_settings
string.comment: Overflow menu item 'Settings' on the app list, in the per-app config and in the key mapper, and a neutral button in dialogs. Opens the Settings screen or the per-app config. Keep it a short noun.

string.name: action_context_delete
string.comment: Long-press context menu item for an app and for a profile, and accessibility label of the delete icon in the file manager. Removes that item.

string.name: action_context_rename
string.comment: Long-press context menu item for an app and for a profile. Opens a dialog to change its display name.

string.name: retry
string.comment: Lowercase negative button in the storage-permission dialog that asks for the permission again. Deliberately lowercase in English.

string.name: err_missing_app
string.comment: Error dialog when an installed app is missing, for example after the storage was unmounted or a shortcut points to deleted data. %s is a storage description already wrapped in quotes and followed by a space (it can be empty), so do not add punctuation around it. Suggests re-creating the shortcut; button Exit.

resources.string: Anwendung nicht gefunden.\nBitte überprüfen Sie die %sVerfügbarkeit des Speichergerätes oder erstellen Sie die Verknüpfung erneut.

string.name: error_disk_io
string.comment: Toast when the app list database fails with a disk I/O error, for example storage is full or was disconnected. Suggests checking free disk space; no period.

string.name: create_apps_dir_failed
string.comment: Error dialog when the working directory cannot be created. %s = folder path, placed inside straight quotes on its own line. Buttons: Choose and Exit.

resources.string: Fehler beim Erstellen eines Ordners im Pfad:\n\'%s\'\nWähle einen anderen.

string.name: change
string.comment: Button in the missing-working-directory dialog: opens a folder picker to choose another location for the working directory.

string.name: choose
string.comment: Positive button in the 'failed to create folder' dialog: opens the folder picker to pick a different working directory.

string.name: warning
string.comment: Dialog title for warnings, for example when the working directory is in a location Android deletes on uninstall, or when no Menu key is assigned in the key mapper. Single short noun.

string.name: scoped_storage_warning
string.comment: Startup warning when the working directory is in app-private storage that Android deletes on uninstall. Contains ... around 'will be deleted'; the folder path is appended right after the colon and the line break. Keep the tags and the trailing colon.

resources.string: Deine Nutzerdaten werden auf deinem Gerät lokal gespeichert und beim Deinstallieren der App <b>automatisch gelöscht<\b>\n

string.name: midlet_name
string.comment: Label before the MIDlet name in the app details shown by the installer (before installing). Contains ... markup and a trailing space; keep both. Not a sentence.

string.name: midlet_size
string.comment: Label before the app file size in the installer's app details. Contains ... markup and a trailing space; keep both. Not a sentence.

string.name: midlet_source
string.comment: Label before the source URL or file path of the app in the installer's app details. Contains ... markup and a trailing space; keep both. The current details view does not display this line, so it is low priority.

string.name: midlet_vendor
string.comment: Label before the app vendor name in the installer's app details. Contains ... markup and a trailing space; keep both. Not a sentence.

string.name: midlet_version
string.comment: Label before the app version in the installer's app details. Contains ... markup and a trailing space; keep both. Not a sentence.

string.name: converting_wait
string.comment: Progress label shown while the JAR is converted to DEX before the first launch. Displayed next to a spinner; keep the ellipsis.

string.name: install
string.comment: Lowercase word used as label and inside installer sentences, meaning 'install this app'. Not a title, no period.

string.name: install_done
string.comment: Success message in the installer dialog after one app was installed. A sentence with an exclamation mark.

string.name: install_jar_non_matched_jad
string.comment: Confirmation when the selected JAR does not match the description in its JAD file. Yes ignores the JAD and installs anyway.

resources.string: Diese App unterscheidet sich von dem, was in JAD beschrieben wird.\nMöchtest du JAD ignorieren und sie trotzdem installieren?

string.name: install_jar_needed
string.comment: Message of the blocking installer dialog when the picked JAD file has no matching JAR: asks the user to choose the JAR. The positive button continues the installation.

string.name: invalid_resolution_not_saved
string.comment: Toast for an invalid custom screen resolution. Not referenced by the current code (invalid values are rejected with the generic 'Error' toast). Low priority.

string.name: warn_install_from_net
string.comment: Informational line in the installer when the picked file is a URL: the file will be downloaded before installing.

resources.string: Die Datei wird aus dem Internet heruntergeladen.

string.name: reinstall
string.comment: Dialog message when the same app is already installed: asks to reinstall and reassures that all data will be kept.

resources.string:
Die App ist bereits installiert.

Möchtest du sie neu installieren?
Alle Daten werden gespeichert.

string.name: reinstall_newest
string.comment: Dialog message when a newer version replaces the installed app. %1$s = version being installed, %2$s = version currently installed. Keep both placeholders and the line breaks.

resources.string:
Diese App auf Version %1$saktualisieren?

Derzeit installiert: %2$s
Alle Daten werden gespeichert.

string.name: reinstall_older
string.comment: Dialog message when an older version replaces the installed app. %1$s = version being installed, %2$s = version currently installed. Warns that saved data may not work with the older version.

resources.string:
Diese App durch Version %1$sersetzen?

Derzeit installiert: %2$s
Ältere Versionen funktionieren gegebenenfalls nicht korrekt.

string.name: loading_info
string.comment: Placeholder text in the installer while the JAR manifest is being read. Lowercase, with ellipsis.

string.name: START_CMD
string.comment: Primary toolbar action on the per-app config screen: starts the MIDlet with the current settings. Displayed as a normal verb, not in capitals.

string.name: CANCEL_CMD
string.comment: Positive button in the key mapper warning about an unassigned Menu key: goes back to the key mapper without saving. Displayed as a normal verb, not in capitals.

string.name: CLEAR_DATA_CMD
string.comment: Overflow menu item on the per-app config screen. Deletes this app's saved data (records, files) after the confirmation message_clear_data.

string.name: RESET_SETTINGS_CMD
string.comment: Overflow menu item on the per-app config screen. Restores all settings of this app to their defaults.

string.name: RESET_LAYOUT_CMD
string.comment: Overflow menu item on the per-app config screen. Discards the custom virtual keyboard layout of this app and restores the default one. 'keylayout' is the in-app term for keyboard layout.

string.name: load_profile
string.comment: Overflow menu item on the per-app config screen and title of the dialog that lists profiles to apply to this app.

string.name: save_profile
string.comment: Overflow menu item on the per-app config screen and title of the dialog that saves the current per-app settings as a reusable profile.

string.name: PREF_SCREEN_OPTIONS
string.comment: Title of the first card on the per-app config screen. Card contains virtual screen size, scaling, orientation, graphics mode and FPS options.

string.name: PREF_SCALE_RATIO
string.comment: Static label to the left of the numeric scaling field in the Screen card. Percent sign is part of the label; the field holds a number such as 100.

string.name: PREF_SCALE_TO_FIT
string.comment: Old scale-mode option from earlier versions, replaced by the Scale type dropdown (pref_screen_scale_type_fit). Not shown in the current UI.

string.name: PREF_KEEP_ASPECT_RATIO
string.comment: Checkbox label in the Screen card. Keeps the original screen proportions when the emulated screen is scaled to the device.

string.name: PREF_FILTER
string.comment: Switch label in the Screen card. Enables texture filtering (smoothing) of the scaled emulated screen; disabling it can speed up slow games.

string.name: PREF_IMMEDIATE
string.comment: Switch label in the Screen card: renders each frame immediately instead of buffering, which fixes image flickering in some games. The Help dialog refers to this option by name.

string.name: PREF_SHOW_FPS
string.comment: Switch label in the Screen card. Draws a frame-rate counter over the emulated screen.

string.name: PREF_FORCE_FULLSCREEN
string.comment: Switch label in the Screen card. Hides the system status and navigation bars while the MIDlet runs.

string.name: PREF_LIMIT_FPS
string.comment: Label to the left of the numeric FPS limit field in the Screen card, and an in-game menu item that opens the same setting as a dialog. Leave room for the value field.

string.name: PREF_FONT_OPTIONS
string.comment: Title of the second card on the per-app config screen, holding emulated font sizes, presets and anti-aliasing.

string.name: PREF_WIDTH
string.comment: Hint inside the numeric field for the emulated screen width in pixels. Disappears once the field has a value; single word.

string.name: PREF_HEIGHT
string.comment: Hint inside the numeric field for the emulated screen height in pixels. Disappears once the field has a value; single word.

string.name: PREF_FONT_SMALL
string.comment: Hint inside the first of three font-size fields (smallest text size). Disappears when a value is typed; single word.

string.name: PREF_FONT_MEDIUM
string.comment: Hint inside the second of three font-size fields (medium text size). Disappears when a value is typed; single word.

string.name: PREF_FONT_LARGE
string.comment: Hint inside the third of three font-size fields (largest text size). Disappears when a value is typed; single word.

string.name: PREF_FONT_SIZE_IN_SP
string.comment: Switch label in the Font card: the three font sizes above are interpreted in scaled pixels (sp) instead of raw pixels. Sentence case; 'Scaled Pixels' is the unit name.

string.name: PREF_BACKGROUND
string.comment: Button next to a hex color field in the Screen card. Opens a color picker for the area around the emulated screen; the field itself uses the separate 'RGB' hint.

string.name: PREF_VIRTUAL_KEYBOARD_OPTIONS
string.comment: Switch label in the Input devices card that shows or hides the on-screen keyboard, and title of the in-game submenu with layout and key-shape items.

string.name: PREF_VK_SHOW
string.comment: Switch label from earlier versions, replaced by 'Virtual keyboard' (PREF_VIRTUAL_KEYBOARD_OPTIONS). Not shown in the current UI.

string.name: PREF_VK_FEEDBACK
string.comment: Switch label in the Input devices card. Vibrates the device when a virtual key is pressed.

string.name: PREF_TOUCH_INPUT
string.comment: Switch label in the Input devices card. Sends touch events to the MIDlet as pointer input.

string.name: PREF_HW_ACCELERATION
string.comment: Old combined hardware acceleration switch from earlier versions, replaced by the Graphics mode dropdown. Not shown in the current UI.

string.name: pref_graphics_software
string.comment: Option in the graphics-mode dropdown: software renderer, the most compatible mode.

string.name: PREF_VK_BACK
string.comment: Button that opens the color picker for the background of keys in their normal (not pressed) state. Short, plural noun; pairs with 'Labels'.

string.name: PREF_VK_FORE
string.comment: Button that opens the color picker for the labels of keys in their normal (not pressed) state. Short, plural noun.

string.name: PREF_VK_OUTLINE
string.comment: Button that opens the color picker for the outline drawn around virtual keys. Short noun.

string.name: PREF_VK_ALPHA
string.comment: Label in front of the opacity slider for virtual keys, with a trailing colon and space. The slider range is 0 to 255.

string.name: PREF_VK_HIDE_DELAY
string.comment: Label in front of the numeric delay field that hides the virtual keyboard after the last touch, with a trailing colon and space. The unit 'ms' follows the field.

string.name: PREF_UNIT_MS
string.comment: Unit label 'ms' shown after the hide-delay field. Abbreviation of milliseconds; usually kept as is in most languages.

string.name: PREF_VK_SEL_FORE
string.comment: Button that opens the color picker for the labels of pressed keys. '(P)' stands for pressed and must stay.

string.name: PREF_VK_SEL_BACK
string.comment: Button that opens the color picker for the background of pressed keys. '(P)' stands for pressed and must stay.

string.name: PREF_VK_KEY_SIZES
string.comment: Heading of the old key-size editor, replaced by the Keyboard layout screen. Not shown in the current UI. Plural noun.

string.name: PREF_VK_NAV_KEYS
string.comment: Label of the old key-size editor for the joystick group, with a trailing colon and space before the size value. Not shown in the current UI.

string.name: PREF_VK_SOFT_KEYS
string.comment: Label of the old key-size editor for soft keys, with a trailing colon and space before the size value. Not shown in the current UI.

string.name: PREF_VK_NUM_KEYS
string.comment: Label of the old key-size editor for the digit keys, with a trailing colon and space before the size value. Not shown in the current UI.

string.name: PREF_VK_FIRE_KEY
string.comment: Label of the old key-size editor for the fire key, with a trailing colon and space before the size value. Not shown in the current UI.

string.name: PREF_VK_SIZE_HINT
string.comment: Hint of the numeric size field in the old key-size editor. Not shown in the current UI. Single word.

string.name: SIZE_PRESETS
string.comment: Opens a list of saved screen-size presets: it is the tooltip and accessibility label of the list icon next to Width/Height, the text of the button in the Font card, and the dialog title in both cases. Plural noun.

string.name: SWAP_SIZES
string.comment: Tooltip and accessibility label of the icon button between the Width and Height fields. Swaps the two values; a verb phrase, no period.

string.name: PREF_SYS_PROPS
string.comment: Title of the System properties card on the per-app config screen. The card lets the user override the J2ME system properties the MIDlet sees.

string.name: PREF_ORIENTATION
string.comment: Label of the screen-orientation dropdown in the Screen card. The values are pref_orientation_default, _auto, _port and _land.

string.name: pref_orientation_default
string.comment: Option in the screen-orientation dropdown: keep the orientation the MIDlet declares (JAD/MIDlet property), no override.

string.name: pref_orientation_auto
string.comment: Option in the screen-orientation dropdown: follow device rotation while the MIDlet runs. Short label in a spinner.

string.name: pref_orientation_land
string.comment: Option in the screen-orientation dropdown: always run this MIDlet in landscape, ignoring device rotation.

string.name: error
string.comment: Generic error title for dialogs and short error toasts across the app (failed file operation, invalid input, profile could not be saved). Single short noun.

string.name: message_clear_data
string.comment: Confirmation dialog message for Clear data. OK deletes the app's data permanently. Question mark.

resources.string: Möchten Sie wirklich die App-Daten löschen?

string.name: PREF_VK_TYPE
string.comment: Intended title 'Keyboard type' of the virtual keyboard type picker. The current dialog is titled 'Switch keylayout' and uses the pref_vk_type_* option strings.

string.name: pref_vk_type_arrows
string.comment: Option in the 'Switch keylayout' dialog that changes the virtual keyboard: arrow keys only, without a digit row. Shown in a single-choice list.

string.name: pref_vk_type_arrows_numbers
string.comment: Option in the 'Switch keylayout' dialog: arrow keys placed above the row of digits. Must stay distinguishable from 'Numbers & arrows'.

string.name: pref_vk_type_custom
string.comment: Option in the 'Switch keylayout' dialog: keep the layout that the user edited and saved.

string.name: pref_vk_type_numbers
string.comment: Option in the 'Switch keylayout' dialog that changes the virtual keyboard: digit keys only, without arrows. Shown in a single-choice list.

string.name: pref_vk_type_numbers_arrows
string.comment: Option in the 'Switch keylayout' dialog: a row of digits placed above the arrow keys.

string.name: pref_vk_type_phone
string.comment: Option in the 'Switch keylayout' dialog: classic phone keypad layout with digits and letters.

string.name: pref_vk_type_phone_arrows
string.comment: Option in the 'Switch keylayout' dialog: phone keypad plus arrow keys. Parentheses are part of the layout name.

string.name: PREF_LAYOUT
string.comment: Label of the hardware key layout dropdown in the Input devices card. The values (Nokia/SE, Siemens, Motorola, Custom, Nokia E62) are intentionally not translated.

string.name: PREF_SHADER_FILTER
string.comment: Label to the left of the shader dropdown in the Screen card, with a trailing colon. Visible only for hardware graphics modes.

string.name: identity_filter
string.comment: First entry of the shader dropdown: the built-in shader that applies no post-processing (fastest). Shown next to the Shader label in the Screen card.

string.name: shader_tuning
string.comment: Title of the Shader Tuning dialog and accessibility label of its tune icon in the Screen card. The dialog appears only for shaders that expose adjustable parameters; shown near a shader dropdown.

string.name: reset
string.comment: Menu item in the Button codes screen and button in the Shader Tuning dialog. Restores default values. Single verb.

string.name: pref_input_devices_title
string.comment: Title of the third card on the per-app config screen: touch input, hardware key layout, key mappings and all virtual keyboard settings.

string.name: pref_graphics_mode_title
string.comment: Label of the graphics-mode dropdown in the Screen card, with a trailing colon. Values are pref_graphics_software, pref_graphics_hw_gles and pref_graphics_hw_view.

string.name: PREF_FONT_ANTI_ALIASING
string.comment: Switch label in the Font card. Enables smoothing of emulated text; keep the hyphenated spelling used in the language.

string.name: pref_screen_gravity_bottom
string.comment: Option in the screen alignment dropdown: pin the emulated screen to the bottom edge.

string.name: pref_screen_gravity_center
string.comment: Option in the screen alignment dropdown: place the emulated screen in the center of the window when it does not fill it.

string.name: pref_screen_gravity_left
string.comment: Option in the screen alignment dropdown: pin the emulated screen to the left edge.

string.name: pref_screen_gravity_right
string.comment: Option in the screen alignment dropdown: pin the emulated screen to the right edge.

string.name: pref_screen_gravity_top
string.comment: Option in the screen alignment dropdown: pin the emulated screen to the top edge.

string.name: pref_screen_scale_type
string.comment: Label of the scaling-mode dropdown in the Screen card. Values are pref_screen_scale_type_none, _fit and _fill.

string.name: pref_screen_scale_type_fit
string.comment: Option in the scaling-mode dropdown: scale the emulated screen so the whole picture fits inside the window, keeping proportions.

string.name: pref_vk_hide_hint
string.comment: Hint inside the empty hide-delay field: an empty value means the keyboard never hides automatically. Lowercase in English.

string.name: unlimited
string.comment: Hint inside the empty FPS limit field: an empty field means no frame-rate limit. All lowercase in English, no period.

string.name: parallel_screen_redrawing
string.comment: Switch label in the Screen card, visible in the software graphics mode. Draws the emulated screen in parallel with the MIDlet thread to improve speed; hidden for hardware modes.

string.name: saved
string.comment: Toast after a profile is saved or a screen-size preset is added. The code passes a profile name as an extra argument but the visible text has no placeholder; do not add one.

string.name: FORCE_CLOSE_CONFIRMATION
string.comment: Message when the user force-closes the running app: warns that data may be lost or the app may break. Buttons OK and Settings; keep the line break.

resources.string: Erzwungenes Schliessen der Anwendung kann zu Datenverlust führen oder die Anwendung beschädigen!\nFortfahren?

string.name: CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED
string.comment: Dialog title for confirmations that can lose data: force-closing the MIDlet and replacing the custom keyboard layout.

string.name: select_dialog_title
string.comment: Dialog title when one JAR contains several MIDlets: the user picks which one to run from a list of names.

string.name: crash_dialog_message
string.comment: Message asking whether to send an error report to the developer. The report contains the crash log; question mark.

resources.string: Möchten Sie ein Fehlerbericht an den Entwickler senden?

string.name: crash_dialog_title
string.comment: Title of the dialog shown after the app has crashed. Short noun phrase; the dialog message asks whether to send a report.

string.name: report_crash
string.comment: Positive button of the crash dialog: sends the error report to the developer. One short verb.

string.name: layout_edit_finished
string.comment: Toast shown the moment edit mode ends, just before the 'save custom keyboard?' dialog. Past tense, short.

string.name: layout_edit_finish
string.comment: In-game menu item that leaves key edit or resize mode and offers to save the changed custom keyboard.

string.name: layout_edit_mode
string.comment: In-game menu item (Virtual keyboard submenu) and Keyboard layout screen menu item. Enters key-position edit mode where virtual keys are dragged to move them. Also shown as a toast.

string.name: layout_scale_mode
string.comment: In-game menu item and Keyboard layout screen menu item. Enters key-resize mode where virtual keys are dragged to resize them. Also shown as a toast.

string.name: layout_switch
string.comment: In-game submenu item and Keyboard layout screen menu item; also the title of the dialog listing keyboard types (those options are pref_vk_type_*). Switches the virtual keyboard layout.

string.name: hide_buttons
string.comment: Menu item and title of the multi-choice dialog listing virtual key names; checked keys become hidden on the keyboard. A plural noun works for both places.

string.name: take_screenshot
string.comment: In-game menu item with a camera icon. Saves a PNG of the emulated screen to the device pictures folder, then shows a toast with the file path.

string.name: screenshot_saved
string.comment: Toast prefix: a space and the saved file path are appended by the app. Do not add a period or a placeholder.

string.name: log_saved
string.comment: Toast after the log file was written to storage. Shown briefly at the bottom of the screen; past tense, no placeholder, no period in English.

string.name: action_lock_orientation
string.comment: Checkable in-game menu item, visible for canvas MIDlets. Locks the current screen rotation while the app runs.

string.name: opt_save_screen_params
string.comment: Checkbox inside the 'save custom keyboard?' dialog, shown only for phone-style keyboards: also save the current positions and sizes of the screen keys. Lowercase, short.

string.name: cmd_menu
string.comment: Label of the left soft key drawn over the emulated MIDlet screen when the MIDlet defines more than one command; tapping it opens the command list. Must be very short to fit a key cap.

string.name: dismiss
string.comment: Default action label of the Android notification used to emulate a MIDlet soft notification: closes it without opening the app. Single verb.

string.name: pref_theme_auto_battery
string.comment: Option in the Theme dropdown: switch to the dark theme automatically while the system Battery Saver is active. 'Battery Saver' is the Android feature name.

string.name: pref_theme_auto_time
string.comment: Option in the Theme dropdown: switch between light and dark automatically depending on the time of day.

string.name: pref_theme_light
string.comment: Option in the Theme dropdown: light color scheme. The chosen theme is shown as the summary of the Theme settings row.

string.name: pref_theme_night
string.comment: Option in the Theme dropdown: dark color scheme. English uses 'Dark', not 'Night'.

string.name: pref_theme_system
string.comment: First entry of the Language dropdown in Settings: use the device language. The same wording is also intended for a 'follow system' theme option, so prefer a neutral phrase such as 'System default'.

string.name: pref_theme_title
string.comment: Settings row title. Opens the theme dropdown whose options are pref_theme_light, _night, _auto_time and _auto_battery; the chosen option is shown as the row summary.

string.name: pref_requires_restart_summary
string.comment: Generic preference summary 'Requires restart'. Not referenced by the current settings XML; kept as a reusable summary for options that need an app restart.

string.name: pref_enable_actionbar_title
string.comment: Switch title in Settings: show the emulator ActionBar (toolbar with the menu) while a MIDlet runs in fullscreen.

string.name: pref_enable_actionbar_summary
string.comment: Shared summary under the ActionBar switch and under the status bar switch: those options apply only to fullscreen applications. Short phrase.

string.name: pref_enable_statusbar_title
string.comment: Switch title in Settings: show the Android status bar over fullscreen MIDlets. The summary below it is the shared 'In fullscreen applications'.

string.name: pref_wakelock_title
string.comment: Switch title in Settings: keep the screen on while a MIDlet runs, so it does not dim or lock during play. No summary.

string.name: pref_vibration_title
string.comment: Switch title in Settings: allow MIDlets to vibrate the device through the J2ME vibration API. Enabled by default; no summary.

string.name: pref_button_shape_title
string.comment: Label of the virtual key shape dropdown. Values are pref_button_shape_oval, _rect and _round.

string.name: pref_button_shape_oval
string.comment: Option in the virtual key shape dropdown: keys are drawn as ovals. Short label inside a spinner.

string.name: pref_button_shape_rect
string.comment: Option in the virtual key shape dropdown: keys are drawn as rectangles with sharp corners. Short label inside a spinner.

string.name: pref_button_shape_round
string.comment: Option in the key shape dropdown: rectangles with rounded corners (distinct from 'Rectangle').

string.name: pref_app_sort_title
string.comment: Title/tooltip of the sort button in the app list toolbar (icon only) and header of its popup menu with the sort orders Name, Date, Vendor.

string.name: pref_app_sort_name
string.comment: Option in the sort popup of the app list toolbar: sort installed apps alphabetically by display name. The active option is checkmarked.

string.name: pref_app_sort_date
string.comment: Option in the sort popup of the app list toolbar: sort installed apps by installation date, newest first. The active option is checkmarked.

string.name: pref_map_keys
string.comment: Full-width button in the Input devices card. Opens the screen where physical device keys are assigned to MIDlet keys (arrows, soft keys, digits).

string.name: pref_encoding_title
string.comment: Button in the System properties card and the title of the dialog listing available text encodings used by the MIDlet. Single noun.

string.name: pref_default_settings
string.comment: Row title from earlier versions; the Settings row now reuses the 'Profiles' title. Not shown in the current UI.

string.name: pref_emulator_dir
string.comment: Settings row title in the Settings screen. Opens a folder picker for the working directory where installed apps and their data are stored.

string.name: pref_screenshot_summary
string.comment: Summary under the Raw screenshot switch: explains that scaling and filtering are turned off for screenshots.

resources.string: Skalierung und Filterung für Screenshots deaktivieren

string.name: pref_screenshot_title
string.comment: Switch title in Settings: take screenshots at the raw emulated resolution, without scaling or filtering.

string.name: mapping_dialog_message
string.comment: Line under 'Press a key' in the key mapper popup. %1$s = the Android key name (for example KEYCODE_A) or the fallback 'not specified'. Keep the placeholder.

string.name: mapping_dialog_key_not_specified
string.comment: Fallback shown instead of the key name in the 'Current mapping:' line when no hardware key is assigned yet. Lowercase in English.

string.name: mapping_dialog_title
string.comment: Heading inside the key mapper popup that waits for the user to press a hardware key. Short imperative, no period.

string.name: reset_mapping
string.comment: Toolbar action in the key mapper. Restores the default key assignments. Single verb.

string.name: save
string.comment: Toolbar action in the Keyboard layout editor and in the Button codes screen. Applies and stores the changes. Single verb.

string.name: error_name
string.comment: Toast shown when the profile name field is empty and the user confirms the dialog. Exclamation mark, very short, no placeholder.

string.name: set_as_default
string.comment: Context menu item for a profile and checkbox in the Save profile dialog. Makes the profile the standard settings for apps installed later.

string.name: edit
string.comment: Context menu item for a profile and for a custom screen-size preset. Opens the editor for that item.

string.name: add_profile_description
string.comment: Tooltip of the plus button in the Profiles screen: creates a new empty profile. Sentence without a period.

string.name: enter_name
string.comment: Title and name-field hint of the dialog that creates a new profile. Sentence case, no question mark.

string.name: enter_new_name
string.comment: Title and hint of the dialog that renames a profile. The name field is prefilled with the current name, which the user replaces.

string.name: set_default_profile_description
string.comment: Tooltip of the 'Set as default' context menu item: the chosen profile becomes the standard settings for all apps installed afterwards. Long sentence, no period.

resources.string: Wähle dieses Profil als Standardprofil für alle weiteren Apps, die du installieren wirst.

string.name: error_name_exists
string.comment: Validation message for a duplicate profile name. Not referenced by the current code; kept for the profile name dialog.

resources.string: Dieser Name ist leider bereits vergeben. Gib einen anderen Namen ein

string.name: default_label
string.comment: Marks the default profile in the Profiles list and the built-in soundbank in the soundbank dropdown. %s is a name (a profile name, or 'Android' for the soundbank) inserted before the word default. Keep the space and the parentheses.

string.name: not_saved_exists
string.comment: Toast when adding or renaming a screen-size preset that already exists. Short phrase, no period.

string.name: alert_rewrite_profile
string.comment: Confirmation when saving a profile under a name that already exists. %1$s = profile name inside straight quotes. Question mark.

resources.string: Ein Profil mit dem Namen: \"%1$s\" existiert bereits.\nMöchtest du es überschreiben?
